parent.description: The node this mirror hangs under. Absent means top level.

sortKey.description: Fractional index ordering this mirror among its siblings.

original.description: The node being mirrored. A bare AT-URI rather than a strongRef, because a mirror must track the live bullet including later edits; a strongRef would pin a CID and freeze the content.

main.description: A live reference rendering another node's subtree in place.
